theme.philosophy: Premium minimalist Indian card room. Dark charcoal/navy felt depth with tactile royal gold and emerald touches. Clean crisp card faces with authentic suits. The table is hero.

game_table.aspect_ratio: rounded-3xl border-2 border-amber-500/30 shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-b from-[#0b1726] to-[#070e18]
game_table.center_trick_area: absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-64 h-64 flex items-center justify-center
game_table.player_hand_fan: fixed sm:absolute bottom-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex items-end justify-center z-30 pointer-events-auto

hud_elements.scoreboard: glassmorphism top-4 left-4 p-3 rounded-xl border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md bg-black/40
hud_elements.tens_tracker: badge counter showing Dehlas (10s) captured by Team A vs Team B with gold icon accents
hud_elements.trump_indicator: top-4 right-4 flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-amber-400/40 bg-black/60 shadow-lg text-amber-400 font-semibold

card_component_styling.card_face: w-14 h-20 sm:w-16 sm:h-24 md:w-20 md:h-28 rounded-lg bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 shadow-md flex flex-col justify-between p-1.5 select-none transition-transform duration-200 hover:-translate-y-3 cursor-pointer
card_component_styling.card_back: w-14 h-20 sm:w-16 sm:h-24 md:w-20 md:h-28 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-900 via-blue-950 to-slate-950 border border-amber-400/40 shadow-md flex items-center justify-center p-1

button_styles.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-amber-600 hover:from-amber-400 hover:to-amber-500 text-slate-950 font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20 active:scale-95 transition-all
button_styles.secondary: bg-secondary/80 hover:bg-secondary text-foreground font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-border/60 backdrop-blur-md active:scale-95 transition-all
button_styles.table_action: bg-black/60 hover:bg-black/80 text-amber-300 border border-amber-400/30 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs tracking-wider uppercase font-bold active:scale-95 transition-all

images.description: Playing cards spread for landing hero section background and room deck visuals
Six card illustration display for game rules and Dehla Pakad cards showcase
Luxury royal cards box for private room lobby, victory chest and tournaments

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts (Cinzel, Plus Jakarta Sans, JetBrains Mono) into public/index.html or @import in index.css.
Implement Dehla Pakad complete flow: 4 seats (North/South = Team 1, East/West = Team 2), dealer rotates clockwise, 13 cards each.
First player after dealer leads; if player cannot follow suit, trump is declared/revealed.
Tens capture logic: When consecutive tricks are won by same team or a trick with 10s is collected, increment team tens count.
Special victory conditions: 4 Tens = Koth (White wash / clean sweep), 13 consecutive tricks = Grand Slam (13 Mann).
Interactive UI must include: Live Chat drawer/popup, audio toggle, emoji quick reactions on avatars, active player turn pulse, responsive hand fan layout.
Ensure both Light Mode and Dark Mode are supported seamlessly with next-themes or state toggle.
Strictly follow all kebab-case data-testid tags in testid_conventions for automated testing verification.
